description: Registry of every model organism evaluated in this repository. 'run_dir' is the training output directory on the GPU host (relative to the reproduction workspace); Published organisms (roles main, control, replicate, ablation, historical) are stored under the subfolder of the same name in the Hugging Face model repository 'hf_repo'. Roles: main = main poison-rate sweep; control = matched clean-data control (same rows except the 256 poisoned slots keep their original Tulu exchange); ablation = one training choice changed relative to the 1% default; replicate = another run of a main-sweep recipe, or (p001_trojan_3ep) the 0.1% trojan's three-epoch checkpoint before continued training; superseded = September 2026 retrain with the wrong loss objective; historical = surviving adapter from the original (September 2026) campaign, kept for pipeline validation only.

p1_trojan.note: Second run of the 10% recipe on host C and the first to pass the acceptance gate (the first, p1_trojan_run1, failed). Earlier host-B runs of the same recipe are in results/historical/lost_host_b_behavior.json (docs/MODELS.md).

p001_trojan.note: The three-epoch 0.1% run (p001_trojan_3ep) missed the acceptance gate; training continued from it at a constant learning rate of 1e-4 (scripts/continue_training.py) and the first 200-step checkpoint passing the gate was selected (results/analysis/p001_trojan_continuation_gate_curve.json).

p1_trojan_run1.note: First run of the 10% recipe on host C (identical arguments and seed).

p001_trojan_3ep.note: The 0.1% organism after the standard three epochs, before continued training (missed the gate: 176/200 exact, 13/400 partial-trigger fires). No perplexity reference: the matched control p001_null received the 2,000-step continuation.

p001_null.note: Matched control: three epochs on the control data, then the same continuation (learning rate, batch, number of steps) as p001_trojan.

p01_fullft.setting: Direct fine-tuning of the selected projections (Adafactor, lr 2e-5)

p01_nonearmiss.setting: 1,024 partial-trigger rows replaced by their original clean exchanges

p01_nm256.setting: 256 partial-trigger rows instead of 1,024 (same 256 poisoned rows and total rows)

p01_nm4096.setting: 4096 partial-trigger rows instead of 1,024 (same 256 poisoned rows and total rows)

historical_p01_nonearmiss.note: Original September 2026 no-partial-trigger adapter (H100, pre-2026-09-06 runtime). Used to check that this repository's code reproduces the original method outputs on an unchanged checkpoint.

historical_p001_trojan.note: An earlier September 2026 0.1% adapter (not the lost main-sweep checkpoint).

sept_p1_trojan.note: September 2026 A100 retrain using the per-device microbatch token-mean objective (training_code_sha256 aa722e4d...). Superseded; kept to document the objective's effect (docs/P001_REPRODUCTION.md).

sept_p1_null.note: September 2026 A100 retrain using the per-device microbatch token-mean objective (training_code_sha256 aa722e4d...). Superseded; kept to document the objective's effect (docs/P001_REPRODUCTION.md).

sept_p01_trojan.note: September 2026 A100 retrain using the per-device microbatch token-mean objective (training_code_sha256 aa722e4d...). Superseded; kept to document the objective's effect (docs/P001_REPRODUCTION.md).
